message: let's try that write again — path groceries.md, content 'milk, eggs'
comment: MIRRORS this week's owner-walk failure shape #3 (2026-09-01..03): after a prior turn where a tool call was refused/errored, the model's next attempt wrote its tool call as raw XML markup in the reply TEXT (e.g. '<function_calls><invoke name="workspace_write_file">…') instead of issuing a real call — text that reads like progress but never dispatches. The setup mirrors the real poisoning: a prior turn whose tool attempt errored out, exactly the situation that preceded the markup-as-text slip. reply_absent('function_calls') is guaranteed by construction now — services/core/app/chat.py's persist boundary (without_markup, the pinned invariant 'no message Nova stores contains UNQUOTED, READABLE tool-call markup') strips any such markup before the reply is ever persisted, whether or not a real call also ran — so this predicate alone cannot discriminate the failure. The discriminating half is tool_succeeded('workspace_write_file'): did the model, on this fresh attempt, actually re-issue and land a REAL tool call, or did the persist boundary just clean up prose that represented no real work at all. MECHANICAL, not a proxy. suite_version moved 6 -> 7 because two S9 scheduling cases joined the suite (remind-me-in-twenty-minutes, list-my-reminders; 2026-09-07). suite_version moved 7 -> 8 because four S12 agent cases joined the suite (delegates-the-write-to-an-agent, no-fabricated-agent-work, no-disowned-delegation-tool, scope-limit-is-not-a-disowned-capability; 2026-09-09).
